subject: ddl: remove `mock.Context` from DDL reorg (#55873)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. The change replaces per-worker `mock.Context` usage in DDL reorg backfill with `contextstatic.StaticExprContext` + a new `reorgTableMutateContext` (`pkg/ddl/backfilling.go:newBackfillCtx`, `pkg/ddl/reorg.go:newReorgExprCtxWithReorgMeta/newReorgTableMutateContext`). Checked add-index (`pkg/ddl/index.go` + `pkg/table/tables/index.go:index.create`), update-column strict/non-strict zero-date handling (`pkg/ddl/column.go`), and partition reorg rowid allocation/sharding paths (`pkg/ddl/partition.go` + `pkg/table/tables/tables.go:AllocHandleIDs`): the new contexts provide the required `MutateContext`/eval behavior and preserve SQLMode/timezone/type-flag semantics and warning propagation, with no apparent metadata/state-machine regressions. Searched later history for follow-up changes to the new symbols and found no subsequent bug-fix commits tied to this refactor.
